munit:test.name: post-case1-normalises-maps-and-returns-201
munit:test.description: Case 1 (Ana Kovač): the System API receives exactly the PDF record; the response is the PDF Process response

munit-tools:assert-equals.message: Record sent to the System API must match the assignment's step 4
Response must match the assignment's step 5

munit:test.name: post-case2-without-phone-omits-phone-and-defaults-sms-consent
munit:test.description: Case 2 (Luka Petrović): no phone field is sent, consent_sms defaults to false, category MINOR

munit-tools:assert-equals.message: phone must be left out, not null

munit-tools:payload.value: #[output application/json --- { patient_id: 'PAT-000124', given_name: 'Luka', family_name: 'Petrović', birth_date: '2012-09-03', sex: 'M', category: 'MINOR', email: 'luka.petrovic@example.com', consent_data_processing: true, consent_sms: false, source: 'PORTAL', status: 'ACTIVE', registered_at: '2026-10-15T10:22:00Z' }]

munit-tools:assert-equals.message: No phone field in the response

munit:test.name: post-case3-senior-with-bracketed-phone-and-sms-consent
munit:test.description: Case 3 (Milena Jović): phone '(065) 222 333' becomes 065222333, SMS consent kept, category SENIOR

munit-tools:payload.value: #[output application/json --- { patient_id: 'PAT-000125', given_name: 'Milena', family_name: 'Jović', birth_date: '1950-01-20', sex: 'F', category: 'SENIOR', email: 'milena.jovic@example.com', phone: '065222333', consent_data_processing: true, consent_sms: true, source: 'PORTAL', status: 'ACTIVE', registered_at: '2026-10-15T10:23:00Z' }]

munit:test.name: post-born-today-is-accepted-as-minor
munit:test.description: Boundary: a date of birth equal to today (clinic time zone) is not in the future

set-payload.value: #[output application/json --- (readUrl('classpath://samples/registration-case2-luka.json', 'application/json') - 'dateOfBirth') ++ { dateOfBirth: ((now() >> p('clinic.timeZone')) as Date) as String }]

munit:test.name: post-case6-future-birth-date-returns-422
munit:test.description: Case 6 rule: a date of birth after today answers 422 INVALID_BIRTH_DATE without calling the System API

set-payload.value: #[output application/json --- (readUrl('classpath://samples/registration-case2-luka.json', 'application/json') - 'dateOfBirth') ++ { dateOfBirth: (((now() >> p('clinic.timeZone')) as Date) + |P1D|) as String }]

munit:test.name: post-case5-without-consent-returns-422
munit:test.description: Case 5 rule: dataProcessing false answers 422 CONSENT_REQUIRED without calling the System API

munit:test.name: post-case7-invalid-request-returns-400
munit:test.description: Case 7: no email and gender 'unknown' are rejected by the spec with 400 BAD_REQUEST

munit:test.name: post-malformed-date-and-blank-name-return-400
munit:test.description: A dateOfBirth not in yyyy-MM-dd form or a whitespace-only first name is rejected by the spec

munit:test.name: post-duplicate-from-system-api-propagates-409
munit:test.description: Case 4 path: a 409 DUPLICATE_PATIENT from the System API reaches the caller as 409, called once

munit-tools:assert-equals.expected: #['A patient with the same name and date of birth already exists.']
munit-tools:assert-equals.message: Message comes from this API's catalogue, not the lower API
